shellCommands.command: find /workspace/app/catalog -type f | head -50 && echo "---APP TREE---" && find /workspace/app -type f -not -path "*/node_modules/*" | head -100
cat /workspace/next.config.* 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; cat /workspace/package.json; echo "---lib/data---"; find /workspace/lib -type f 2>/dev/null
(npm run start -- -p 3100 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2; curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | head -30; echo "---catalog sale---"; curl -s "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale"

curl -s -D - -o /tmp/prefetch.out "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale&_rsc=dqR7R9QVVV_bHJGW" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Ctrue%5D"; echo "---BODY---"; grep -o "Products on sale" /tmp/prefetch.out; grep -o "Canvas Tote" /tmp/prefetch.out; grep -o "Loading category" /tmp/prefetch.out

pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
(cd /workspace && npm run dev -- -p 3101 > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 &) 
sleep 4
curl -s "http://localhost:3101/catalog?category=sale" > /dev/null
curl -s "http://localhost:3101/" > /dev/null
sleep 2
cat /tmp/next-dev.log
cat /tmp/next-dev.log 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ps aux | grep "next" | grep -v grep
kill 361 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; ps aux | grep next | grep -v grep
